presenterNote: One client app replays a malformed biz_req_input -> identical 5151 technical exceptions repeating for one usr_id/session. Distinguish a single-client poison loop from a systemic outage via incidence checks.
title: Poison retry loop
expectedOrigin: a single misbehaving client/session replaying a malformed request
decoy: high count of identical 5151 technical exceptions (looks like a systemic outage)
description: One client repeatedly replays a malformed biz_req_input, producing a loud 5151 count — but incidence is 1 user / 1 session. A client-side technical loop, not a systemic failure. Discriminator is incidence, not error count.
